generation.rule: populations must separate across 0.5, the midpoint of the metric's documented range; boundary = midpoint(worst faithful, best hallucinated); margin_min = half the observed separation; floored to 3dp

retrieval.rule: floor = the score when exactly one of n queries slips one rank, floored to 3dp. mrr rejects a worse slip or a second regression; recall@1 counts rank 1 only, so it rejects a second one
